required_files.rationale: Per-instance plan/diff orchestration in terraform core at v1.7.0 (the eval_diff.go/eval_refresh.go files of older cores no longer exist)
aws_iam_policy schema with the policy-document normalization hooks
aws_security_group Read and the ingress/egress rule-set schema (the pre-v4 aws/resource_aws_security_group.go layout is gone)

sufficient_files.rationale: ProposedNew: how core merges prior state and config into the planned value
Plan entry point that drives refresh + diff

drift_points.description: aws_iam_policy stores the policy document as a string; AWS returns it canonicalized, so the Read value differs byte-for-byte from config. The schema counters with DiffSuppressFunc verify.SuppressEquivalentPolicyDiffs, DiffSuppressOnRefresh, and a StateFunc that runs structure.NormalizeJsonString; core's plan compares the values structurally and shows a phantom diff whenever the suppression layer and AWS canonicalization drift

aws_security_group ingress/egress are schema.TypeSet blocks hashed by SecurityGroupRuleHash; the provider Read returns rules in AWS order and MatchRules re-aligns them with config. When the hash inputs and the returned rule shape disagree (rule fields added or aggregated differently), the set hash changes and core plans a phantom update even though nothing material changed

scoring_evidence._comment: Every graded token is ABSENT from instruction.md (checked raw and whitespace-stripped, both lowercased) and verified PRESENT at the pinned revs: SuppressEquivalentPolicyDiffs + DiffSuppressOnRefresh + NormalizeJsonString StateFunc at internal/service/iam/policy.go:85-91 and PolicyToSet at policy.go:208 (provider v5.31.0); SecurityGroupRuleHash as the ingress/egress Set function at internal/service/ec2/vpc_security_group.go:128; ProposedNew at internal/plans/objchange/objchange.go:31 and AssertObjectCompatible at internal/plans/objchange/compatible.go:29 (terraform v1.7.0). The prompt DOES supply aws_iam_policy, aws_security_group, aws_lambda_function, phantom diff, JSON normalization, set vs list ordering and the terraform/ package name -- none of those may be graded alone. File-existence context: internal/terraform/eval_diff.go and eval_refresh.go do NOT exist at v1.7.0; they were the old required_files and graded nothing real.
